description: Remove a webhook. Deleting an agent's webhook makes that agent fall back to the project-level webhook; deleting the project-level webhook stops events for agents using that default until you set one again (agents with their own webhook are unaffected). Pass agent_id to remove an agent's webhook, or omit it to remove the project-level webhook.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to delete that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

name: delete_webhook

outputSchema.description: Confirmation that the webhook was removed.

title: Delete Webhook
